fields.name: ItemMaterial
fields.evidence: ecl::inventory::SoundSystem::SetInventorySoundSwitches (EoCClient.dll+0xE265A0) gets the item's switch data (FUN_180e21860) and, when +0 != -1, sets sound switch "Item_Material" (strItem_Material) and also "Weapon_Material" to this FixedString. Live: valid FixedString indices; macOS RefreshItemUnderlyingGroundMaterial also updates it.

fields.name: WeaponType
fields.evidence: Toolkit EoCClient.dll+0xE20520 / ecl::inventory::SoundSystem::SetInventorySoundSwitches (+0xE265A0) set the sound switch named by DAT_181a3ae00 from +8; that global is created from the string "Weapon_Type" (EoCClient.dll+0x16CBD0). | first pass: SetInventorySoundSwitches sets the switch named by global FixedString EoCClient.dll+0x1A3AE00 (name not resolved) from +8. Live: -1 or a valid index.

fields.name: WeaponTypeUnique
fields.evidence: Same setters, switch DAT_181a3ade8 = "Weapon_Type_Unique" (EoCClient.dll+0x16CC00), value from +0xC. | first pass: SetInventorySoundSwitches sets the switch named by global FixedString EoCClient.dll+0x1A3ADE8 (name not resolved) from +0xC.

fields.name: AttackType
fields.evidence: Toolkit EoCClient.dll+0xE20E30 sets switch DAT_181a3adf8 = "Attack_Type" from +0x14. | first pass: Live: -1 or a FixedString index like its neighbours; macOS default constructor fills 0x00-0x1F with one 16-byte pattern (all FixedStrings). Not used by SetInventorySoundSwitches.

fields.name: WeaponDamageType
fields.evidence: Toolkit EoCClient.dll+0xE20E30 sets switch DAT_181a3ade0 = "Weapon_DamageType" from +0x18. | first pass: As field_14 (FixedString-shaped live values, same default).

fields.name: ItemGoldSize
fields.evidence: SetInventorySoundSwitches sets switch "Item_Gold_Size" (strItem_Gold_Size) from +0x20. Live: always -1 (no gold among the 48 samples).

fields.name: MaterialType
fields.evidence: Toolkit EoCClient.dll+0xE20520 sets switch strMaterial_Type ("Material_Type") from +0x24 when != -1. | first pass: Live: always the same FixedString index 0x2F200010 (a default value); macOS default stores x0 (non-zero pair) at +0x20.

fields.evidence: Default 0 (stp xzr, xzr, [x23, #0x30]). Live: mostly 0, sometimes 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFF00; not decoded.
